page.overview:
What is Team Crimson Bolt?

Team Crimson Bolt was a team participating in the racing skiff competition Kublop Classic. The team consisted of pilot Nash Durango, droid RJ-83, and Jedi younglings Kai Brightstar, Nubs, and Lys Solay.
